notes.title: Update 11.05.2022 (Patch 1)
notes.content:
The first patch of the update included:
- Changed the speed of opening/closing doors
- Removed all hints on the items for the task 
- Fixed a bug in the text in Russian
- Changed the sequence of triggering frightening elements 
- Some adjustments have been made to the tasks
- Some details of the interior and garage have been changed

notes.title: Future update 07.05.2022
notes.content:
I am currently working on additional content in the game, new tasks will be added to the game. the location of the game will also be increased, new frightening elements will be added, and in addition to all this, new languages will be introduced into the game.
We accept your recommendations for the game and updates in the mail (some will even get into the game in upcoming updates) studio_phantom@mail.ru

notes.title: Patch 2.8 (Paranormal phenomenon)
notes.content:
As many people know by the release date, the game is getting ready for a full release in the store this month! Now the project is undergoing a thorough analysis, revision and modernization, as well as localization of the game, and discussions are already underway on future innovations. 

First of all, I decided to add two more languages, these are Japanese and Korean, they will have automatic translation, perhaps in the future, in addition to the existing ones, some other languages will be added. 

Also, more complex puzzles appeared in the game, in order for the entire gameplay to be somehow diluted and some complexity appeared, you will also have to think a little, this is a small part of what was done! Let's talk about the appearance of the game world.

Now I complement the interior of the house for greater realism and a sense of presence there with small and medium details that do not catch the eye, but have a place to be in this house. 

In addition to everything else, the game is currently being tested for performance on weak systems, and I'm trying to optimize it as much as possible.

At the moment I want to say that this is the main news that I can tell you, thank you for following and waiting!
